preview: Guyana Amazon Warriors face Jamaica Kingsmen in CPL 2026 Match 26 at Providence Stadium. The match is scheduled for Fri 4 Sep at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: Guyana retain Shimron Hetmyer, Romario Shepherd, Shai Hope and Shamar Joseph, while 10 of their 12 locally selected players come from Guyana. The CPL's newest franchise restores a Jamaica-based men's team, led by a local group featuring Rovman Powell, Andre Russell and Odean Smith. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
